messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor and James,

Further to discussions with Calderstone, please find attached a mutual non-disclosure agreement for the proposed transaction. Once signed we can open the data room and begin diligence. Do let us know if you'd like your advisers to review first.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
